status_summary: No NIC composition rule or outside-chair appointment reporting to the Principal Deputy DNI was found. Reported ODNI actions are structural and personnel moves of a different kind: ODNI said in May 2025 that the acting NIC chair and his deputy had been fired and that the NIC was moving from CIA locations to ODNI buildings, and ODNI's August 2025 fact sheet folds core functions of three centers into Mission Integration and the NIC, eliminates the Strategic Futures Group and moves the NIC from the Reston campus to the main ODNI campus.

timeline.event: AP reported, citing an ODNI email, that the acting NIC chair and his deputy were fired and that the NIC was being moved from CIA locations to ODNI buildings.

ODNI 2.0 fact sheet said core functions of three centers are folded into Mission Integration and the NIC, the NIC moves from the Reston campus to the main ODNI campus, and the Strategic Futures Group is eliminated (the fact sheet is undated; the date is that of the announcement).

title: Require at least half non-CIA officers on the NIC and an outside chair under the PDDNI
uncertainties: The relocation and firings are related to the Mandate's goal of independence only loosely and do not implement its 50 percent rule or chair design; they are shown as context and the stage is not_started. Who currently chairs the NIC, and the NIC's current agency mix, were not found; internal staffing may not be public. The Senate-reported FY2026 authorization bill (S. 2342, Sec. 405) would have reformed the NIC and National Intelligence Officers, but no NIC section appears in the table of contents of the enacted Division F of Public Law 119-60 or, by title, in the Senate's FY2027 bill.
